title: Detection Is Harder Than Estimation in Certain Regimes: Inference for Moment and Cumulant Tensors
summary: We study estimation and detection of high-order cumulant tensors from $n$ i.i.d. observations of a $p$-dimensional random vector, with performance measured in the tensor spectral norm. Under sub-Gaussianity, we show that the minimax rate for estimating the order-$d$ cumulant tensor is $\sqrt{p/n}\wedge 1$.
